name: How do I file a property damage claim after a car accident in San Diego?

mainEntity.name: How do I file a property damage claim after a car accident in San Diego?

acceptedAnswer.text: File your property damage claim with the at-fault driver’s insurance, your own insurance (if you have collision coverage), or directly with the responsible party. Provide documentation such as repair estimates, photos, and police reports for faster processing.seriousaccidents+1​
